photo.caption: Five phases · your sign-off between each

scope.title: Scope stretches the phases.
scope.note: A larger scope lengthens every phase after discovery, development most. It never adds, reorders or skips a phase or a sign-off. The bars above show our smallest and largest published scopes; discovery counts as one day. A flexible deadline, or content written from scratch, can stretch a quote to {ceiling} weeks, never further.

payments.text: Payment follows the same order: one part to start, one at a development milestone named in your proposal, and the last before production launch. Code, designs and accounts pass to you at final payment.

flexibility.description: Describe the project in a few lines and we arrange the initial project consultation call. The proposal that follows fixes scope, price and timeline before you sign.
flexibility.title: Start with phase one.
flexibility.titleItalic: Tell us what you are building.

footer: Payment follows the phases: one part to start, one at a development milestone, the last before launch.

hero.description: How an Altruvex project runs from discovery to launch: what each phase produces, what we need from you, who signs off, and which payment falls where.
hero.title: Web design process:
hero.titleItalic: five phases, in a fixed order.

design.headline: Agree on the whole design before a line of code.
design.deliverables: Visual mockups | Responsive layouts | Brand alignment
design.inputs: Brand assets: logo, colours, type | Feedback within the agreed revision rounds
design.description: We design the full interface on that structure. You review it and request revisions within scope; development starts after your approval.
design.title: 03 - Design

development.headline: Build it on a live link you can open any day.
development.inputs: Feedback on the live preview | Access to the services the build connects to
development.description: We build on a live preview link you can open at any time. The development-milestone payment falls at the point named in your proposal.
development.title: 04 - Development

discovery.headline: Understand the problem before proposing a solution.
discovery.deliverables: Requirements summary | Review of what exists today | Proposal: scope, price, timeline
discovery.inputs: The goal | What exists today | The constraints
discovery.description: It starts with the initial project consultation call: 30 minutes, at no charge. You share the goal, the constraints and what exists today; we ask the questions that surface the real requirements. The proposal that follows sets scope, price and timeline.
discovery.title: 01 - Discovery

launch.headline: Review it on staging, then it goes live on your domain.
launch.inputs: Your review on staging | Access to your domain | The final payment
launch.description: We set up hosting and deliver the finished build to staging for your review. Deployment to your domain follows once the final payment clears; source code, documentation and accounts pass to you at that payment. No lock-in.
launch.title: 05 - Launch

wireframe.headline: Agree the pages and flows before any visual design.
wireframe.inputs: Copy and assets, or the key messages | Feedback on the sitemap and flows
wireframe.description: We map the sitemap, page structure and key flows. You approve the structure before any visual work begins.
wireframe.title: 02 - Wireframe

subtitle: Every project moves through discovery, wireframe, design, development and launch - in that order, with your sign-off before the next phase starts.
title: Five phases. Your sign-off between each.
